messages:
Nisha: quick flag — quota dashboard shows a sudden gap for a customer after last week's client releases
Omar: link?
Nisha: https://console.internal/redwood/tenant/xyz/usage — tokens fall to zero for a few hours even though traffic continued
Priya: could be routing policy mismatch between SDKs and the proxy. Any errors in traces?
Jules: found a pattern: TS client started sending `route_meta: {team: \"infra\"}` as an object, python still sends `route_meta: \"team:infra\"` as colon-delimited string
Nisha: ugh. console parsing expects k/v map; colon-delimited fallback was a legacy hack which we removed in parsing v2
Omar: suggested immediate mitigation: add a tolerant parser on the ingest path that accepts both forms and emits a normalized map + a migration tag
Priya: agree. short-term shim on ingest to recover attribution, long-term fix in SDKs. Who owns TS/Go changes?
Jules: TS owner is @omar, Go is in platform-libs team (not in this thread) — I'll ping them separately
Omar: I'll push a small patch in TS to serialize route_meta as an object and include a deprecation WARN in logs for one release. No behavior change for existing consumers besides the log
Nisha: console: can you add `route_meta_shape` metric and a per-tenant chart so we can track progress? Also add a dashboard alert if >2% of tokens are unattributed for a tenant
Priya: yes, adding metric and alert now. tagging events with `route_meta:migration-2026-03` during the shim period
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: ingest-tolerant-parser-canary -> 2026-03-21 15:30 PT, 5% traffic, id: d-49876-canary
Jules: test matrix note: batch requests can contain mixed shapes across items; shim must normalize item-by-item
Omar: TS PR open: ts#422. Includes tests for single item string, object map, and mixed batch. Will coordinate Go PR with platform-libs.
Nisha: good. once canary stable, we'll roll to 100% and remove old parsing code after two weeks. Add a short note to #devex so SDK users know when to upgrade
Priya: canary healthy after 25m. unattributed tokens dropped to baseline for canary traffic
Jules: rolling to 25% now. keep monitoring per-tenant charts
Nisha: thanks all. follow-up: make sure changelog and migration docs include examples (TS/Go snippet + python note).
